name: bastiondesk
description: Plataforma de agendamiento para profesionales y oficios

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.sec:scan:container: trivy image --exit-code 0 $(docker inspect --format='{{.Image}}' bastiondesk-dev 2>/dev/null || echo 'bastiondesk-dev') 2>/dev/null || echo '[!] Container not running — skipping image scan'
scripts.sec:scan: concurrently --names "SECRETS,SAST,DEPS" --prefix-colors "red,yellow,blue" "npm run sec:scan:secrets" "npm run sec:scan:sast" "npm run sec:scan:deps"
scripts.env:setup: cp -n server/.env.example server/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n client/.env.example client/.env 2>/dev/null || true && echo '✅ .env files created — edit them with your values'
